subject: Mythology
title: Lugh: The Master of All Skills
description: A quick, practical guide to Lugh: The Master of All Skills.

hook.text: When Lugh arrived at the gates of Tara, the guard asked what skill he had. Lugh named every one that existed.

buildup.text: He was a warrior, harper, poet, sorcerer, smith, and healer — master of every art known to the Celts.

discovery.text: He was half god and half giant, born between two warring races and destined to unite their strengths.

twist.text: He killed his own grandfather Balor by hurling a sling stone through his single destructive eye in battle.

climax.text: The festival of Lughnasadh, celebrated on August 1st, honored him and became one of Ireland's great holidays.

punchline.text: He mastered everything, then got a harvest festival named after him.

quiz.question: How did Lugh defeat his grandfather Balor?
options: He challenged him to a contest of all skills
He hurled a sling stone through Balor's destructive eye
He used magic to seal Balor inside a mountain
